summary: REELS surface (GAMES -> REELS) tested end-to-end, backend + frontend. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases PASS in test_reels_surface.py. /api/reels returns the correct {league, collections, total, enabled} shape for nhl/whl/ncaa; NHL surfaces GAME HIGHLIGHTS with playable YouTube clips (youtube_id + playable=true); WHL surfaces GAME HIGHLIGHTS; NCAA surfaces real GOALS + SAVES + FIGHTS with the youtube_id-null => playable=false invariant holding, and some NCAA clips carry a resolved game_id. Empty collections are omitted by design (verified). /api/reels/search Silvertips at league=whl returns Silvertips WHL clips; Silvertips at league=nhl scope=league returns honest empty; Silvertips at league=nhl scope=all bridges via All-Hockey and returns WHL clips (league_code=whl); 'ncaa goals' at scope=all routes to category=goals with all NCAA results; q=x (<2 chars) returns empty results without error. Regressions clean: /api/search montreal -> Canadiens, /api/highlights 200, /api/nhl/standings 200. Frontend: Onboarding welcome-go -> region-usa -> interest-nhl -> interests-next -> onboard-search 'Minnesota' -> result-team-MIN -> skip x3 lands on tabs shell. nav-games -> games-seg-reels loads REELS pane with the four top modes (NEXT/RECAP/REELS/STATS), a reels-search input, a visible LeagueSwitcher (NHL/WHL/OHL/QMJHL/NCAA), a GAME HIGHLIGHTS collection with 40 real clip cards (reel-<id>), and the 'Verified video · Highlightly' credit. Playback: tapping a clip opens the modal with an inline YouTube player (iframe rendered) plus reels-close for NHL clips; NCAA clips without youtube_id fall back to OPEN VIDEO. Content-is-navigation: crest-<ABBR> chip on a clip card routes to /team/CAR correctly, independent from the play tap. Search: 'Silvertips' at league=NHL shows honest empty state ('No verified video' + 'Search All Hockey' link) and the reels-scope toggle switches to All Hockey and returns 13 Silvertips clips; 'Hurricanes' at league=NHL returns 15 verified clip rows. League rail switching within REELS: NHL/WHL/NCAA all reload collections without leaving REELS (WHL -> GAME HIGHLIGHTS, NCAA -> GOALS/SAVES/FIGHTS). Four LeagueSwitcher instances mounted (one per Games pane) confirmed by testID collisions (4 elements per league key, 1 visible in the REELS pane) — matched using visible-only filter as advised. No red-screen errors. Deprecated packages detected: none. Only pre-existing RN Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, props.pointerEvents) carry over from prior iterations — non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' warning still emitted on RN web (multiple screens). Non-blocking, carry-over from prior iterations.

action_items: (Optional carry-over) Migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence the RN web deprecation warning across screens.
critical_code_review_comments: ReelsHub.tsx cleanly separates browse-feed (api.reels with useEffect on [league]) from search (debounced 220ms on [q, league, scopeAll]) with abort guards via `alive` flag — good pattern, no races observed.

ClipCard and ClipRow both expose testID=`reel-<id>` on the play Pressable and testID=`crest-<ABBR>` on the crest chip Pressables; independent from the parent card so play tap != crest tap by construction. Modal also exposes navChips with reels-viewgame testID when game_id resolved.

Playback path: youtube_id -> YoutubeInline (iframe); else -> OPEN VIDEO Pressable that Linking.openURL(active.url). Non-embeddable sources correctly fall through. No autoplay-of-next mechanism in code (single active clip via useState) — matches 'No autoplay loop'.

Backend /api/reels omits empty collections (server.py L1201-1207 uses buckets.setdefault + list comp keeping only non-empty) — matches spec. NCAA fallback contract holds: youtube_id null => playable false (verified in all 40 returned clips).

LeagueSwitcher is mounted 4x (one per Games pane), so any testID=`league-<code>` selector matches 4 elements. Tests must filter by is_visible() to hit the REELS-pane instance — an alternative would be to unmount hidden panes, but current display:none approach preserves state and is a reasonable trade-off.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 8 acceptance flows verified: nav to Reels, top modes, search input, league rail, clip cards, credit, modal playback (YouTube inline + OPEN VIDEO fallback), crest -> Team, search honest-empty + scope toggle, WHL/NCAA league switching)

seed_data_creation: None — live Highlightly data. Onboarded 1 follow (team MIN) to exit onboarding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: REELS is fully functional. Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_reels_surface.py is idempotent and safe to rerun (uses .env base URL, only GETs, no seed writes).
